The '''''Ithor Lady''''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] cruiser stationed at [[Cybloc XII/Legends|Cybloc XII]]. The warship was destroyed by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] [[Needle fighter]] vessels.
